narrative:
Summit County has 374,925 registered voters, with 56.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 16.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 26.5%, a clear Democratic lean of 9.9 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.6% of registrants.
